description.en: A repeated facade panel or precast segment has a width; the connection also occupies space. Count both before measuring the whole.
description.sr: Ponovljeni fasadni panel ili prefabrikovani segment ima širinu; i spoj zauzima prostor. Pre ukupne mere prebroj oba.

try.en: Use n=5 panels, w=400 mm and g=10 mm. Check L=nw+(n−1)g=2040 mm. With n=1, the internal-joint count must become zero.
try.sr: Uzmi n=5 panela, w=400 mm i g=10 mm. Proveri L=nw+(n−1)g=2040 mm. Kada je n=1, broj unutrašnjih fuga mora biti nula.

boundary.en: Our counting model excludes end clearances, tolerances and connection strength. Grid coordination is an idea to examine, not a construction approval.
boundary.sr: Naš model brojanja izostavlja krajnje zazore, tolerancije i čvrstinu spoja. Koordinacija rastera je ideja za istraživanje, ne odobrenje za izvođenje.

description.en: A ceiling grid or formwork diagram shares internal boundaries. Adding every panel's edges counts those boundaries twice.
description.sr: Mreža plafona ili shema oplate deli unutrašnje granice. Sabiranje svih ivica svakog panela te granice broji dvaput.

try.en: Draw nx=2 by ny=3 cells. Check six cells and J=(nx−1)ny+(ny−1)nx=7 unique internal segments. Mark the two neighbours of each segment.
try.sr: Nacrtaj nx=2 puta ny=3 polja. Proveri šest polja i J=(nx−1)ny+(ny−1)nx=7 jedinstvenih unutrašnjih segmenata. Obeleži dva suseda svakog segmenta.

boundary.en: This original grid abstraction counts segments, not screws, connectors or total seam length. Real joints need a separate specification.
boundary.sr: Ova naša apstrakcija mreže broji segmente, ne šrafove, spojnice ili ukupnu dužinu fuga. Stvarni spojevi traže poseban opis.

source.title: OpenStructures · shared grid; our counting adaptation

title.en: The grid fits. The hole does not.

description.en: Matching hole positions can help align partition or plate components, while their outlines still make the connection impossible.
description.sr: Jednaki položaji rupa mogu poravnati delove pregrade ili ploče, dok njihov obris ipak onemogućava spoj.

try.en: Set hole spacing p=40 mm, diameter d=10 mm and end distance e=4 mm. Draw L=p+2e=48 mm. Check e−d/2=−1 mm: the hole crosses the end.
try.sr: Zadaj razmak rupa p=40 mm, prečnik d=10 mm i rastojanje centra od kraja e=4 mm. Nacrtaj L=p+2e=48 mm. Proveri e−d/2=−1 mm: rupa prelazi kraj.

boundary.en: Our geometric counterexample checks one edge collision. A positive remaining edge does not establish strength, tolerances or a suitable fastener.
boundary.sr: Naš geometrijski kontraprimer proverava jedan sudar sa ivicom. Pozitivan rubni ostatak ne potvrđuje čvrstinu, tolerancije ni odgovarajuće spojno sredstvo.

description.en: Placing canopy markers or stations along a route needs an endpoint policy. A fixed step and two fixed ends describe different rules.
description.sr: Raspored oznaka nadstrešnice ili stanica duž trase traži pravilo za kraj. Fiksni korak i dva fiksna kraja opisuju različita pravila.

try.en: For L=10 m and s=3 m, compare 0,3,6,9 with four equal intervals: 0,2.5,5,7.5,10. Also check L=1.2 m, s=0.4 m: four stations, including the end.
try.sr: Za L=10 m i s=3 m uporedi 0,3,6,9 sa četiri jednaka intervala: 0,2.5,5,7.5,10. Proveri i L=1.2 m, s=0.4 m: četiri stanice, uključujući kraj.

boundary.en: Our geometry prompt is not a support-spacing design. Decimal arithmetic needs an explicit numerical tolerance; endpoint snapping must not conceal a material remainder.
boundary.sr: Naš geometrijski predlog nije projekat razmaka oslonaca. Decimalni račun traži izričitu numeričku toleranciju; pridruživanje kraju ne sme sakriti stvaran ostatak.

source.title: Onshape · Numeric Fields; our station-placement idea

description.en: Bookings for one studio tool or one construction resource can favour either the number of jobs or their assigned value.
description.sr: Rezervacije jednog studijskog alata ili građevinskog resursa mogu dati prednost broju poslova ili njihovoj zadatoj vrednosti.

try.en: Use intervals [0,2), [2,4), [0,4), with weights 1,1,10. Earliest finish selects two jobs worth 2; the third alone is worth 10. Name the objective before comparing.
try.sr: Uzmi intervale [0,2), [2,4), [0,4), sa težinama 1,1,10. Najraniji završetak bira dva posla vrednosti 2; treći sam vredi 10. Imenuj cilj pre poređenja.

boundary.en: Only fixed intervals on one resource are considered. The maximum-count result does not establish a maximum-weight or whole-site schedule.
boundary.sr: Posmatraju se samo fiksni intervali jednog resursa. Najveći broj poslova ne potvrđuje najveću težinu niti raspored celog gradilišta.

title.en: The largest piece can leave a gap

description.en: A bench or an abstract line of precast parts makes a small search problem visible: an attractive first choice can block a better combination.
description.sr: Klupa ili apstraktan niz prefabrikovanih delova čini mali problem pretrage vidljivim: privlačan prvi izbor može zatvoriti bolju kombinaciju.

try.en: Fill length 8 using uncut parts of lengths 6,4,3 in the same unit, with unlimited copies. Compare largest-first 6 with 4+4. Check remainders 2 and 0.
try.sr: Popuni dužinu 8 nekratljivim delovima dužina 6,4,3 u istoj jedinici, uz neograničen broj kopija. Uporedi najveći-prvo 6 sa 4+4. Proveri ostatke 2 i 0.

boundary.en: Our separate packing counterexample omits joints, cutting and cost. Its small finite search says nothing about the speed of general optimisation.
boundary.sr: Naš zaseban kontraprimer slaganja izostavlja spojeve, sečenje i cenu. Njegova mala konačna pretraga ne govori o brzini opšte optimizacije.

source.title: MIT 6.046J · algorithm objectives; our separate packing example

title.en: Keep the recipe with the seed

description.en: Panel orientations or synthetic inspection marks can vary while remaining replayable. A seed is only one part of the record.
description.sr: Orijentacije panela ili sintetičke oznake pregleda mogu se menjati uz mogućnost ponavljanja. Seed je samo deo zapisa.

try.en: Specify a 4×3 grid, seed 17, p=0.5, generator/version and row-first traversal. Generate twice and compare all 12 entries. Then change only the traversal and inspect the difference.
try.sr: Zadaj mrežu 4×3, seed 17, p=0.5, generator/verziju i obilazak po redovima. Generiši dvaput i uporedi svih 12 stavki. Zatim promeni samo redosled obilaska i pogledaj razliku.

boundary.en: This is a replay idea, not a tested implementation. Half-probability does not guarantee six choices of each kind; different seeds need not yield different finite patterns.
boundary.sr: Ovo je ideja ponavljanja, ne proverena implementacija. Polovična verovatnoća ne garantuje šest izbora svake vrste; različiti seedovi ne moraju dati različite konačne šare.

title.en: A facade is a small grammar

description.en: One rectangle can produce levels and bays. The same hierarchy could organise a facade sketch or named zones in an inspection diagram.
description.sr: Jedan pravougaonik može dati nivoe i polja. Ista hijerarhija može organizovati skicu fasade ili imenovane zone sheme pregleda.

try.en: Split W=12 m, H=9 m into three levels and four equal bays per level, without gaps. Check 12 leaves, each 3×3 m, and total area 108 m².
try.sr: Podeli W=12 m, H=9 m na tri nivoa i četiri jednaka polja po nivou, bez fuga. Proveri 12 listova, svaki 3×3 m, i ukupnu površinu 108 m².

boundary.en: This original deterministic rule sketch is not copied CityEngine code. Equal subdivision verifies neither useful rooms nor daylight, structure or assembly details.
boundary.sr: Ova naša deterministička skica pravila nije preuzet CityEngine kod. Jednaka podela ne potvrđuje upotrebljive prostorije, dnevno svetlo, konstrukciju ili detalje sklapanja.

source.title: Esri CityEngine · rule alternatives; our deterministic subdivision idea

title.en: First a word. Then a shape.

description.en: A pergola rhythm or a schematic sequence of parts can separate the order of symbols from their geometric meaning.
description.sr: Ritam pergole ili shematski niz delova može razdvojiti redosled simbola od njihovog geometrijskog značenja.

try.en: Start A; replace A→AB and B→A simultaneously twice. Check ABA. Give A length 2 m and B length 1 m: total 5 m. Change only A to 3 m: total 7 m, same word.
try.sr: Počni sa A; dvaput istovremeno zameni A→AB i B→A. Proveri ABA. Dodeli A dužinu 2 m, a B dužinu 1 m: ukupno 5 m. Promeni samo A na 3 m: ukupno 7 m, isti niz.

boundary.en: Our spatial interpretation illustrates rewriting. It does not simulate biological growth or load-bearing behaviour; keep a small explicit iteration limit.
boundary.sr: Naše prostorno tumačenje ilustruje zamenu simbola. Ne simulira biološki rast ni nosivost; broj koraka ostaje izričito ograničen.

source.title: Prusinkiewicz & Lindenmayer · The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants, §1.1–1.3

title.sr: Koja mera treba da se prilagodi?

description.en: A fixed facade width or structural diagram can contain a variable number of equal fields. Decide which dimensions are inputs and which are derived.
description.sr: Fiksna širina fasade ili konstruktivne sheme može sadržati promenljiv broj jednakih polja. Odredi koje mere su ulazi, a koje izvedene.

try.en: Set W=2400 mm, e=100 mm, g=20 mm and n=4. Check w=(W−2e−(n−1)g)/n=535 mm, then rebuild the total. Convert every length to metres and check the same shape.
try.sr: Zadaj W=2400 mm, e=100 mm, g=20 mm i n=4. Proveri w=(W−2e−(n−1)g)/n=535 mm, pa ponovo sastavi ukupnu meru. Pretvori sve dužine u metre i proveri isti oblik.

boundary.en: Our dependency model requires integer n≥1, nonnegative margins/gaps and w>0. An impossible input should be reported, not silently repaired by changing another decision.
boundary.sr: Naš model zavisnosti traži ceo broj n≥1, nenegativne rubove/fuge i w>0. Nemoguć unos treba prijaviti, ne tiho popravljati promenom druge odluke.

title.en: A roof's area is not its volume

description.en: A symmetrical roof sketch links span, rise and length to several different quantities. Keep their meanings and units visible.
description.sr: Skica simetričnog krova povezuje raspon, uspon i dužinu sa više različitih veličina. Njihova značenja i jedinice treba da ostanu vidljivi.

try.en: Use W=6 m, L=10 m, rise r=4 m. Check slope length 5 m, two-slope area 100 m² and triangular-prism volume 120 m³. Double all lengths: area ×4, volume ×8.
try.sr: Uzmi W=6 m, L=10 m, uspon r=4 m. Proveri kosu dužinu 5 m, površinu obe ravni 100 m² i zapreminu trougaone prizme 120 m³. Udvostruči sve dužine: površina ×4, zapremina ×8.

boundary.en: This is our elementary geometry model, without eaves, thickness, waste, joints or forces. Enclosed roof volume is not roofing-material quantity.
boundary.sr: Ovo je naš model elementarne geometrije, bez strehe, debljine, otpada, spojeva ili sila. Zapremina ispod krova nije količina krovnog materijala.

source.title: Onshape · dependent dimensions; our roof-geometry example

description.en: A building mass or temporary site element can be tested against a deliberately simple envelope before adding more detail.
description.sr: Masa zgrade ili privremeni element gradilišta može se proveriti prema namerno jednostavnom omotaču pre dodavanja detalja.

try.en: Use an 18×14 m envelope and invented margin s=2 m. A centred, axis-aligned 14×10 m rectangle fits exactly. Increase its width to 14.1 m: report failure, not a squeezed drawing.
try.sr: Uzmi omotač 18×14 m i izmišljeno odstojanje s=2 m. Centriran pravougaonik 14×10 m, paralelan osama, tačno staje. Povećaj širinu na 14.1 m: prijavi neuspeh, ne sabijen crtež.

boundary.en: Our invented margin is not a planning rule. The two inequalities exclude rotation, irregular boundaries, access, safety and other permit requirements.
boundary.sr: Naše izmišljeno odstojanje nije urbanistički propis. Dve nejednakosti ne obuhvataju rotaciju, nepravilne granice, pristup, bezbednost i ostale uslove dozvole.

source.title: Onshape · variable-driven geometry; our envelope check

description.sr: Geometrijska kutija, zid i zapis o materijalu mogu izgledati isto.

try.en: Compare the picture with the ID, units, entity type and source of a property.
try.sr: Uporedi sliku sa ID-jem, jedinicama, tipom elementa i izvorom svojstva.

title.en: What a building's passport must answer
title.sr: Na šta pasoš zgrade mora da odgovori

description.en: A digital passport is not one fixed form. It is whatever record lets a later reader trust what an object is, where it came from and how it may be reused.
description.sr: Digitalni pasoš nije jedan zadat oblik. To je zapis koji kasnijem čitaocu dozvoljava da poveruje šta je objekat, odakle dolazi i kako može ponovo da se upotrebi.

try.en: Pick one real or imagined object: a wall, a stair, a facade panel. List every question a stranger would need answered before trusting or reusing it. Sort your questions into identity, material, origin and evidence.
try.sr: Izaberi jedan stvaran ili zamišljen objekat: zid, stepenice, fasadni panel. Nabroj sva pitanja koja bi nepoznata osoba morala da ima odgovorena da bi mu verovala ili ga ponovo upotrebila. Razvrstaj pitanja u identitet, materijal, poreklo i dokaz.

boundary.en: There is no single official passport schema here; this is a teaching exercise in defining one, not an approved compliance format.
boundary.sr: Ovde ne postoji jedinstvena zvanična šema pasosa; ovo je nastavna vežba definisanja, a ne odobren format usklađenosti.

title.en: From quarry to wall, who signs each step?
title.sr: Od kamenoloma do zida, ko potpisuje svaki korak?

description.en: A material has a story before it becomes a wall: quarry or producer, carrier, warehouse, craftsman, engineer, architect. Each can leave a distinct record.
description.sr: Materijal ima priču pre nego što postane zid: kamenolom ili proizvođač, prevoznik, stovarište, majstor, inženjer, arhitekta. Svaki može ostaviti zaseban zapis.

try.en: Draw one arrow chain for your object: origin → processing → storage → installation. Under each arrow, write the one fact that would prove that step happened, and who could provide it.
try.sr: Nacrtaj lanac strelica za svoj objekat: poreklo → obrada → skladištenje → ugradnja. Ispod svake strelice napiši koja jedna činjenica bi dokazala da je korak izvršen i ko bi je mogao dati.

boundary.en: This chain is a simplified teaching model; real supply chains branch, mix batches and lose records. Naming an actor is not the same as holding their signed evidence.
boundary.sr: Ovaj lanac je pojednostavljen nastavni model; stvarni lanci snabdevanja se granaju, mešaju partije i gube zapise. Imenovanje aktera nije isto što i imati njegov potpisan dokaz.

title.en: Reuse needs proof, not just age
title.sr: Ponovna upotreba traži dokaz, ne samo starost

description.en: An old beam is not automatically safe to reuse. Circular construction asks what was verified, by whom, and whether the passport survived demolition.
description.sr: Stara greda nije automatski bezbedna za ponovnu upotrebu. Cirkularna gradnja pita šta je provereno, ko je proverio i da li je pasoš preživeo rušenje.

try.en: Imagine your object is salvaged from a demolished building. List what the passport would need to carry through demolition for it to be reused with confidence. Mark which parts of your earlier chain survive, and which are lost.
try.sr: Zamisli da je tvoj objekat spasen iz rušenja. Nabroj šta pasoš mora da preživi rušenje da bi se objekat ponovo upotrebio sa poverenjem. Obeleži koji delovi tvog ranijeg lanca opstaju, a koji se gube.

boundary.en: A thought exercise, not a structural reuse certification. Real reuse requires inspection and engineering sign-off beyond any digital record.
boundary.sr: Misaona vežba, ne sertifikacija za ponovnu konstruktivnu upotrebu. Stvarna ponovna upotreba traži pregled i inženjersku saglasnost izvan bilo kog digitalnog zapisa.

title.en: A lecture can become a sequence of decisions.

try.en: Our adaptation: an explicit prediction, a visible result, and an explanation of the discrepancy beside the same short code example.
try.sr: Predvidi, proveri i objasni razliku u istom prikazu.

boundary.en: Different instructors and multiple simultaneous changes; the hardware's effect is not isolated. This is not a long-term, 400-student website evaluation.

title.en: Close the example. Rebuild the steps.

description.en: Two experiments with 80 and 120 undergraduates compared learning science texts. Retrieval practice outperformed studying with concept maps on tests one week later, including inference and concept-mapping outcomes.

try.en: Our adaptation: after learning, hide the example and reconstruct the steps before reopening it for self-checking.
try.sr: Sakrij primer, obnovi postupak, uporedi.

boundary.en: Short texts in laboratory settings; not direct evidence for a quick classroom prediction or architectural software competence. Concept mapping from memory can itself involve retrieval.

source.title: Retrieval Practice Produces More Learning than Elaborative Studying with Concept Mapping

title.en: A phone with a defined job.

description.en: In large introductory physics sections, observers detected no significant distraction difference between mobile polling and dedicated clickers. Active periods were associated with less distraction than passive periods.
description.sr: Vrsta aktivnosti zaslužuje pažnju uz izbor uređaja.

try.en: Our adaptation: brief, purposeful phone interaction followed by a discussion prompt; the screen need not remain the centre of every activity.
try.sr: Telefon služi konkretnom pokušaju, potom se pažnja vraća obrazloženju.

boundary.en: Observational, institution-specific data from 2014–2015; no significant difference does not establish equivalence, causation or absence of distraction today.
boundary.sr: Rad ne dokazuje da telefon nikada ne ometa učenje.

source.title: Requiring Mobile Devices in the Classroom: the Use of Web-Based Polling Does Not Lead to Increased Levels of Distraction

title.en: Shuffle the table, keep the neighbours

description.en: Our exercise separates where records are stored from the relationships they describe.
description.sr: Naša vežba razdvaja redosled čuvanja zapisa od odnosa koje opisuju.

try.en: Use A B C / D E F with edge-only adjacency. List the records as F,A,D,C,B,E. Find B’s neighbours (A,C,E), reorder the table and explain why that set stays fixed.
try.sr: Uzmi A B C / D E F, gde susedi dele ivicu. Zapiši redove kao F,A,D,C,B,E. Pronađi susede B (A,C,E), preuredi tabelu i objasni zašto taj skup ostaje isti.

boundary.en: Coordinates and the adjacency rule are explicit teaching assumptions. Corner contact is excluded; this is not a pedestrian-route model.
boundary.sr: Koordinate i pravilo susedstva su eksplicitne nastavne pretpostavke. Dodir uglom je isključen; ovo nije model pešačkih putanja.

source.title: Larkin & Simon · Why a Diagram is (Sometimes) Worth Ten Thousand Words

title.en: Change the storage, keep the promise

description.en: Our exercise assigns data, calculation and drawing to three people with an agreed exchange format.
description.sr: Naša vežba dodeljuje podatke, račun i crtež trima osobama uz dogovoren format razmene.

try.en: Return ID/width_m/height_m for three 600×1200 mm panels with 20 mm internal gaps. Change internal storage from mm to m while keeping the exchange in metres. Check positions 0,0.62,1.24 m, width 1.84 m and panel area 2.16 m².
try.sr: Vraćaj ID/širina_m/visina_m za tri panela 600×1200 mm sa unutrašnjim razmacima 20 mm. Promeni unutrašnji zapis iz mm u m, a razmenu zadrži u metrima. Proveri položaje 0;0,62;1,24 m, širinu 1,84 m i površinu panela 2,16 m².

boundary.en: Our analogy for responsibility and interfaces, not a claim that any three-stage pipeline achieves information hiding. Unknown IDs and missing dimensions need explicit errors.
boundary.sr: Naša analogija odgovornosti i interfejsa, ne tvrdnja da svaka podela na tri faze postiže skrivanje informacija. Nepoznati ID i nedostajuća mera traže eksplicitnu grešku.

source.title: Parnas · On the Criteria To Be Used in Decomposing Systems into Modules

title.sr: Dva tačna podzbira mogu da zavaraju

description.en: Our exercise follows one shared identity through two groups and a change to the whole.
description.sr: Naša vežba prati jedan zajednički identitet kroz dve grupe i promenu celine.

try.en: A contains P1/P2/P3; B contains P3/P4/P5. At 0.60×1.20 m each, both subtotals are 2.16 m² but the unique total is 3.60 m². Make P3 1.50 m high: each subtotal becomes 2.34 m² and the unique total 3.78 m².
try.sr: A sadrži P1/P2/P3; B sadrži P3/P4/P5. Svaki ima 0,60×1,20 m: oba podzbira su 2,16 m², a jedinstveni zbir 3,60 m². P3 povisi na 1,50 m: podzbirovi postaju po 2,34 m², a jedinstveni zbir 3,78 m².

boundary.en: Static identity/counting model. It does not demonstrate Simon’s dynamical theory, structural strength or emergent collective behaviour.
boundary.sr: Statički model identiteta i brojanja. Ne pokazuje Simonovu dinamičku teoriju, čvrstinu konstrukcije ili nastajanje kolektivnog ponašanja.

title.en: Make instructions for the next team

description.en: Our exercise makes a small artefact useful to another person, then uses an unsuccessful attempt to reveal the rule.
description.sr: Naša vežba pravi mali predmet koristan drugoj osobi, pa neuspešnim pokušajem otkriva pravilo.

try.en: Four paper parts A–D have removable joints AB,BC,CD. Our rule requires AB before BC before CD. Give another team only the operations. Reject a first step BC, explain why, fix it and record the changed state.
try.sr: Četiri papirna dela A–D imaju odvojive spojeve AB,BC,CD. Naše pravilo traži AB pre BC pre CD. Drugoj ekipi daj samo operacije. Odbij prvi korak BC, objasni razlog, popravi ga i zabeleži promenjeno stanje.

boundary.en: Original reversible toy model. Removing CD,BC,AB works under these stated dependencies; it is not demolition advice. A polished animation alone does not establish the learner’s understanding.
boundary.sr: Originalni reverzibilni školski model. Uklanjanje CD,BC,AB važi pod zadatim zavisnostima; nije savet za rušenje. Dopadljiva animacija sama ne utvrđuje razumevanje studenta.

source.title: Brennan & Resnick · New frameworks for studying and assessing the development of computational thinking
